messageTemplate.intro: I'm setting up Helicone integration and need help. Here are my details:
messageTemplate.closing: I am new to Helicone. Can you help me integrate it into my application?

requestsTable.title: Welcome to Requests!
requestsTable.description: View all your request and response data here after adding one line of code to your LLM app.
requestsTable.accordionTitle: How to send requests to Helicone?
requestsTable.accordionBody: If you are using the proxy method (recommended), simply add one line of code to start sending requests to Helicone.

requestsDrawer.title: Let's dive deeper
requestsDrawer.description: See the complete request with all messages exchanged with the LLM, metadata, and key metrics. Notice anything unusual in the response? Let's investigate what might have gone wrong.

sessionsPage.title: We are in the travel planning session
sessionsPage.description: Each session shows you the complete chain of LLM calls and how they connect. Here you can trace through every step of the travel planning process to find where things started going wrong.

sessionsCulprit.title: The Culprit
sessionsCulprit.description: The "extract-travel-plan" step is where things went wrong. Let's go improve this prompt.
sessionsCulprit.accordionTitle: How do I track sessions in Helicone?
sessionsCulprit.accordionBody: Depending on your library, you will need to add 3 headers to your request to start tracking your sessions and traces.

promptsPage.title: Welcome to Prompts!
promptsPage.description: Here, you can view the latest "extract-travel-plan" prompt in production, its version history and previous requests.
promptsPage.accordionTitle: How do I track my prompts in Helicone?

promptsExperiment.title: Let's iterate on this prompt
promptsExperiment.description: Let's improve this prompt to give us better travel plan extractions. Click here to start experimenting.

experimentsTable.title: A playground for prompts
experimentsTable.description: This is where you can create variations of your prompt, test them against real data, and measure which performs best.

experimentsOriginal.title: Here's your original prompt
experimentsOriginal.description: This is your "extract-travel-plan" production prompt. Let's create a new version to test against it.

experimentsAdd.title: Add an experiment
experimentsAdd.description: Click here to create a new variation of your prompt.

experimentsAddChangePrompt.title: Change the prompt
experimentsAddChangePrompt.description: Try adding step-by-step reasoning to help the model better understand and extract travel plans.

experimentsAddSave.title: Save changes
experimentsAddSave.description: We already picked a model for you. Go ahead and save your prompt.

experimentsFindExperiment.title: You can find your experiment here
experimentsFindExperiment.description: Now let's test it on some production inputs. This is a crucial step to make sure our new prompt didn't regress.

experimentsAddTestCases.title: Add infinite test cases
experimentsAddTestCases.description: Test with real data from your users for more realistic results.

experimentsRunExperiments.title: Run experiments
experimentsRunExperiments.description: Sometimes it takes multiple experiments to achieve the highest prompt accuracy. Add as many as you need.

experimentsSpecificEval.title: Evaluate your output
experimentsSpecificEval.description: Let's attach an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator that assesses the output to make sure the user's travel plan is successfully extracted.

experimentsRunEval.title: Run evaluator
experimentsRunEval.description: Running evaluators will quantify the output quality and make sure it didn't regress.

dashboardSuccess.title: Congrats! You resolved the issue
dashboardSuccess.description: Now you can monitor error rates, latency, and costs over time to catch anomalies that could suggest new issues.
